pr.body:
## Review repair
- Uses ConPort HTTP REST port defaults for decisions API calls.
- Accepts string decision IDs and compares IDs as strings.
- Threads requested limits through GET /api/decisions and uses a bounded lookup window for search/show/write validation.
- Fixes styled_table invocation, nested POST response ID parsing, and append-only reference wording.
- Validates referenced decisions before review/outcome writes.
- Adds focused unit coverage for all new command paths and updates the command-registration snapshot.

## Test Plan
- Validate Task Packet JSON/schema.
- Run focused decisions command tests and command registration snapshot.
- Run git diff --check and pre-commit on changed files.
